required_inputs: repo_root;interface BASE ancestry;frozen imported design source;design BASE Git objects
validation_rule: builder and evaluator accept interface BASE descendants only when imported design worktree and HEAD bytes retain the frozen SHA

semantic_name: external authority maps and file-path inputs are forbidden

semantic_name: typed in-memory submissions are passed without mutation
validation_rule: canonical deep snapshots are equal after evaluation

semantic_name: core ingestion semantics delegate to committed design module
required_inputs: typed in-memory inputs;validated committed-design context;committed design evaluator
validation_rule: read-only runtime integrity attestation precedes exactly one design ingest_review_batch call
field order and exact types equal frozen Exact6

semantic_name: interface response hash is deterministic and self-excluding

semantic_name: all result and authority records retain committed Exact18/Exact27 semantics
validation_rule: committed design validators pass every record and digest

semantic_name: interface evaluation has no filesystem persistence side effects
required_inputs: in-memory evaluator call;interface Exact4 artifact lifecycles;legal public descendants

semantic_name: implementation materializes no real review, result, authority or downstream label

validation_rule: five masks,zero of five modules integrated,training false
